text:
hiro: Quick pulse check 1 getting tired of ad-hoc handoffs between hosted/dedicated/private. Proposal: a tiny "session capsule" we use everywhere. It contains routing hints + opaque secret refs + a capability vector. Keep direct key material out unless explicitly allowed.

marta: +1 on capsule idea. We need strict semantics for "opaque ref" vs "inline material". Private deployments can allow inline, hosted must never.

raj: What do you mean by capability vector? Give an example.

hiro: Example capabilities: `can_resolve_kms`, `can_cache_creds`, `allows_inline_keys`, `migration_aware`. Capsules negotiate these at handshake. Control plane advertises allowed caps; adapter replies with supported caps.

marta: Also include `telemetry_tag` (hashed) so adapters can emit traces w/o the tenant name. Avoid exposing tenant_id in logs.

security-bot: policy-check: hosted nodes flagged as "no_inline_keys" by default. Any change requires security review and an allowlist.

raj: Operationally: if capsule has `resolve_policy=lazy`, and resolve fails mid-request, what's the fallback? Route to cheaper hosted model? Return 503?

hiro: We should define deterministic error classes: `RESOLVE_TEMP`, `RESOLVE_PERM`, `POLICY_VIOLATION`. Behavior map: TEMP -> retry/backoff; PERM -> fallback route or abort depending on `fallback_policy` in capsule; POLICY_VIOLATION -> abort + audit.

marta: Also a migration flow. When affinity moves we need a `migration_token` and `grace_seconds` to allow KV caches to be warmed. Without that, latency spikes and cache churn.

raj: Suggest capsule schema sketch (tiny):
```json
{"tenant_hash":"h-xx","affinity_hint":"zone-3","secret_ref":"kmsp://r/abcd","caps":["can_resolve_kms","can_cache_creds"],"resolve_policy":"lazy","fallback_policy":"degrade_to_small","manifest_v":"2","migration_token":null}
```

hiro: Key constraints: 1) manifest version must be explicit; 2) capability negotiation happens before resolving any secret; 3) adapters must fail fast if they see `manifest_v` they don't support.

marta: For private installs, document patterns: if `allows_inline_keys=true`, control plane must still sign the capsule and customer infra must rotate keys frequently. Make the default false.

security-bot: checklist: require audit_nonce, signed_manifest, minimal TTL, and RBAC mapping for who can request `allows_inline_keys`.

raj: Telemetry: include `telemetry_id` = HMAC(tenant_id, rotation_secret) so it's stable across requests but not reversible. Adapters should only log telemetry_id.

hiro: Failure modes and runbook idea: if `RESOLVE_TEMP` persists past `ttl/2` -> control plane issues migration capsule to a different affinity and `grace_seconds` starts. If `RESOLVE_PERM` -> immediate fallback route.

marta: Edge-case: some dedicated customers want caching at adapter level but disallow host KMS resolution. We should support an intermediate mode: `resolve_intent=customer_gateway` meaning adapter expects short-lived token from customer's gateway (not host KMS).

ops: infra-note: test matrix queued: manifest-v2 compatibility, resolve-policy-lazy/fallback, migration-grace-sims.

hiro: Action items: raj to draft capsule JSON Schema + error codes, marta to write private/dedicated policy doc and allowlist workflow, ops to add tests. I'll pull into a brief RFC draft after we have schema.

marta: One more: add `caps_hash` in capsule so runtime can assert integrity before resolving. On mismatch, abort with `MANIFEST_HASH_MISMATCH`.

security-bot: policy reminder: any change to `allows_inline_keys` requires design review + security sign-off.

hiro: Cool. If nobody objects I'll open the RFC PR with the capsule idea and the handshake flow. Drop objections here in 24h. :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:
